scenario.topic: Select a transport pass for a week in London

options.name: 7-Day Travelcard Zones 1-2
options.upside: Covers central London zones with unlimited travel on major public transport modes.
options.concern: Limited to zones 1 and 2, which may not cover outer areas some travelers need.

options.name: 7-Day Travelcard Zones 1-4

attrs.modes_included: Tube, Bus, DLR, Overground, National Rail

options.upside: Includes outer zones and National Rail services within London for broader coverage.
options.concern: Higher cost compared to zones 1-2 pass, which may be unnecessary if travel is mostly central.

options.name: 7-Day Bus & Tram Pass
options.upside: Allows unlimited bus and tram travel across all London zones at a lower price.
options.concern: Does not include Tube or rail services, which may limit travel speed and options.

options.name: 7-Day Oyster Card Pay-As-You-Go Cap

attrs.modes_included: Tube, Bus, DLR, Overground, National Rail

options.upside: Flexible pay-as-you-go with a weekly cap, covering all zones and transport modes.
options.concern: Cost depends on travel patterns and may exceed fixed pass prices if used extensively.

shared_context: A group of three people needs to select a transport pass valid for one week in London. Each pass covers different zones, modes of transport, and pricing structures suitable for frequent travel within the city.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a project manager who frequently travels across all London zones for work and leisure.
personas.private_goal: Maximize flexibility and coverage without worrying about daily costs.

A.reason_for: Covers central zones with unlimited travel on major modes, suitable for some trips.
A.reason_against: Limited zones 1-2 coverage is insufficient for her frequent outer zone travel.

B.reason_for: Includes outer zones and National Rail, offering broader coverage than zones 1-2 pass.
B.reason_against: Higher price than zones 1-2 pass and less flexible than Oyster pay-as-you-go cap.

C.reason_for: Low price and unlimited bus/tram travel across all zones.
C.reason_against: No Tube or rail service included, limiting speed and options for her varied travel.

D.reason_for: Flexible pay-as-you-go with a weekly cap, covering all zones and transport modes she needs.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a student who mostly travels by bus and tram within London’s outer zones.
personas.private_goal: Keep transport costs low while maintaining access to all bus and tram routes.

A.reason_for: Affordable and covers central London zones with unlimited travel on major modes.
A.reason_against: Does not cover outer zones where he occasionally travels.

B.reason_for: Broader zone coverage including outer zones and National Rail.
B.reason_against: More expensive than he prefers given his limited use of rail services.

C.reason_for: Lowest price and unlimited bus and tram travel across all zones, matching his main travel modes.

D.reason_for: Covers all zones and modes with a weekly cap.
D.reason_against: Potentially higher cost and complexity than his budget allows.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a part-time consultant who travels sporadically but prefers comprehensive coverage.
personas.private_goal: Avoid surprises in transport costs while having access to all zones and modes.

A.reason_for: Covers central London with unlimited travel on major modes.

B.reason_for: Includes outer zones and National Rail, offering broader coverage.

C.reason_for: Low cost and unlimited bus/tram travel across all zones.
C.reason_against: Excludes Tube and rail, limiting her travel speed and options.

D.reason_for: Flexible pay-as-you-go with a weekly cap, covering all zones and modes, matching her preference for cost control and coverage.
